name: Theo
description: The sleeper: round cream-peach head, brown bowl hair, navy pill body, stick limbs; variants: X-ray, underwater-tinted, lavender-graded.

name: Edison (Thomas Edison cameo)
description: Same template as Theo with pale grey-beige swept hair, black suit, white shirt, bow tie.

name: stage high
description: Spotlight stage: a dark green wood-panelled room with a dado rail, a bare pendant bulb with a visible light cone, an oval wooden frame holding a grey silhouette portrait, a small light switch, a wood-plank floor, a large concentric brown/cream ring rug, a ring of round wooden stools, a central wooden chair, two white metal plates.

name: stage side dark
description: The same stage from a 3/4-side angle and darker: the bulb pool only, black surroundings, ring rug, chair with a plate on the floor.

name: stage pov rug
description: Top-down POV of the ring rug and chair seat slats (the hands and belly are character layers).

name: menlo park lab
description: Thomas Edison's Menlo Park laboratory: a long wooden hall with ceiling beams, tall shelves of glass bottles on both walls, a back wall with the sign 'MENLO PARK : LABORATORY', organ pipes, dark windows, a pendant bulb, a brass gramophone horn on the left, round wooden stools, a wooden chair, plank floor, floating dust motes.

name: depth chart
description: Sleep-depth cross-section: a dark brown room above a wavy water surface; teal water with god-rays; a violet glow band between dashed wavy lines with floating confetti doodles; a navy-black deep zone; a thin depth-ruler pole at the left (labels and EEG are overlays).

name: underwater band
description: A closer view inside the depth chart at LIGHT SLEEP / the violet band, with caustics and floating doodles.

name: corkboard
description: A cork pinboard filled with cream paper idea cards (black line icons + caps labels) pinned with red pins and linked by red strings.

name: elevator hypnagogia
description: Vintage elevator car interior: dark wood panelling, ceiling dome lamp, a red carpet runner, a semicircular floor dial above the door (A L H D), a brass scissor gate drawn over the left half of the doorway, side plaques and a button strip; through the door, a purple-lit 'HYPNAGOGIA' floor with a spotlight and a round display platform.

name: elevator deep sleep
description: The same elevator at the DEEP SLEEP floor: the outside wall is dark brick with a white caps sign '…P SLEEP' (DEEP SLEEP), and the whole interior is graded blue-lavender.

name: steel ball
description: A polished chrome steel ball, about palm-size, with strong environment reflections and a white specular highlight.

name: metal plate
description: A white enamel / metal pie plate with concentric rings and a small orange tab or sticker on the rim.

name: ball in plate
description: A chrome ball resting in the plate (the end-state composite).

name: wooden chair
description: A simple wooden ladder-back chair with turned legs and stretchers, warm honey wood with thin dark contour lines.

name: round stool
description: A small round wooden stool with three splayed legs (props sit on them: plates, balls, a book).

name: pendant bulb
description: A bare incandescent bulb on a cord with a brass socket, glowing, with a volumetric cone below.

name: oval portrait
description: An oval wooden picture frame holding a generic grey silhouette 'avatar' portrait.

name: ring rug
description: A large round rug of concentric brown and cream rings (a hypnotic target motif).

name: gramophone horn
description: A brass gramophone horn on a stand (Edison-era prop).

name: magnet car model
description: A 3D display model of the 'magnet car' gag: a green pickup truck with a white jointed rod frame dangling a red horseshoe magnet in front of the bumper, on a round dark platform with red rope stanchions, under a spotlight.

name: elevator floor dial
description: A semicircular brass floor-indicator dial with letters A, L, H, D (Awake / Light / Hypnagogia / Deep) and a needle; the H sector is highlighted purple.

name: depth chart brain waves
description: The sleep-depth infographic with labels and the EEG trace: AWAKE (at the surface), LIGHT SLEEP, the violet band with '? ? ?' (unlabelled = hypnagogia), DEEP SLEEP (lavender), a tiny 'BRAIN WAVES' title at top right, and a mint EEG line (tight zigzag → spiky burst in the band → slow big waves). Text: AWAKE · LIGHT SLEEP · ? ? ? · DEEP SLEEP · BRAIN WAVES

name: corkboard web
description: An idea corkboard: 13 cream paper cards with black line icons and caps labels, red pushpins, red strings connecting unrelated ideas. Text: FISH · UMBRELLA · KEY · KITE · TEACUP · BOOT · DUCK · GEAR · TRUCK · MAGNET · WHEEL · BICYCLE · TEAPOT

name: card key
description: A single idea card (template for all cards): cream paper, a red pushpin at top, a black line icon of a key, a thin rule, and the caps label. Text: KEY

name: card magnet car
description: The merged invention card: a green pickup truck with a driver; a white jointed rod frame from the truck bed arches over the cab and dangles a red horseshoe magnet in front of its own bumper (a perpetual-motion gag); a yellow pushpin and a red '!!' in the corner. Text: MAGNET CAR · !!

name: notepad magnet car
description: A spiral-top notepad page (pinkish paper, faint red ruled lines) with the MAGNET CAR sketch and a red italic handwritten caption. Text: MAGNET CAR!

name: menlo park sign
description: A painted wall sign in the lab: gold serif caps on dark wood, with organ pipes between the words. Text: MENLO PARK  LABORATORY

name: deep sleep floor sign
description: The floor sign seen through the elevator door: white heavy caps on a dark brick fascia (the left part is hidden by the gate). Text: DEEP SLEEP (visible: '…P SLEEP')

name: xray body
description: A cutaway diagram of Theo as an X-ray: translucent blue body, pink brain, a plug tag, a glowing nerve wire to the hand holding the ball. Text: (no text)

name: ov_caption_word
description: Word caption: heavy rounded sans (Montserrat ExtraBold / Poppins Bold look), white fill, black outline about 4 px plus a soft shadow, centred, baseline y≈900, 1–3 words, hard-cut per word. Build: Code / AE text layer driven by word timings. Not an image.

name: ov_hypnagogia_title
description: Keyword title card 'HYPNAGOGIA': heavy geometric caps, pale lavender fill #dddaf3, dark navy outline #212b4b, soft shadow, thin underline; fades in 6 frames and out 3 frames. Build: AE text layer with stroke + drop shadow; opacity keys 816–822 in, 850–853 out.

name: ov_eeg_trace
description: Mint EEG line (#a2e7df) with a soft glow, drawn top→down: tight zigzag, a spiky burst inside the violet band, then slow big waves. Includes the tiny 'BRAIN WAVES' label. Build: Shape path + trim paths 0→100 % over 18 frames; glow effect.

name: vfx_sparkle_glint
description: A white 4-point star glint on chrome balls; scale 0→1→0 over 10–15 frames. Build: Sprite / shape star with glow.

name: vfx_impact_arcs
description: Thin white semicircle arcs above the plate, spawning every 2–3 frames and expanding/fading (the ball smash sound). Build: AE ellipse strokes, scale 0→300 %, opacity 100→0, stagger 3 frames.

name: vfx_impact_arcs_double
description: The same arcs, doubled over both plates on the elevator crash. Build: As above, two emitters.

name: vfx_scanline
description: X-ray scan line: a bright cyan horizontal line with glow sweeping vertically and revealing the X-ray layer above it (down at #373–383, up at #555–564). Build: Linear wipe track matte + glowing solid line, 10 frames per sweep.

name: vfx_eyelid_vignette
description: POV eyelids: near-black bands with feathered curved edges closing from the top and bottom (close, reopen a bit, close). Build: Two masked solids, feather about 40 px, keyed position.

name: vfx_iris_zoom_through
description: Zoom-through into the pupil: the face tears into fragments, the iris fills the frame, the pupil opens with torn-paper edges onto the next scene. Build: Exponential scale + shatter + torn-paper alpha matte.

name: vfx_card_merge
description: Two idea cards slide together, overlap with a ghost and pop into a bigger new card with a slight overshoot. Build: Position keys + cross-fade + scale overshoot (110 %→100 %).

name: vfx_floor_scroll_blur
description: Floors scrolling past the elevator door with vertical motion-blur streaks. Build: Tall 2D strip translated in Y behind the door matte, with motion blur.

name: vfx_sweat_drop
description: A pale-blue teardrop sweat drop with a dark outline on the forehead. Build: Face-rig sprite; fades out after about 30 frames.

name: vfx_vibration_lines
description: Faint short parallel arcs beside the head (shaken/annoyed). Build: Shape layer with wiggle.

name: vfx_water_caustics_bubbles
description: An animated white caustic network over the character plus rising bubbles (underwater). Build: AE CC Caustics / fractal noise in overlay mode, or a Blender shader; bubble particles.

name: vfx_cross_dissolve_ghost
description: The signature 4–8 frame cross-dissolve with the incoming shot slightly zoomed (ghost layering). Build: Opacity cross-fade over 5–6 frames with a 102–105 % scale settle.

name: vfx_unplugged_wire
description: The nerve wire in its unplugged state: a dull mauve-grey zigzag hanging from the plug tag (vs. the glowing straight pale-yellow double line when plugged). Build: Two shape-path versions swapped on one frame (#405, #537).

name: vfx_red_string_draw
description: Red string drawing from one pushpin to another (4–5 frames per string). Build: Stroke path + trim paths; a slight sag curve.
